summary: Aris Mining Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting an early warning update regarding its sale of 15,500,000 common shares of Seasif Exploration Inc. at C$0.005/share for C$77,500 gross proceeds. Pre-sale holding was 20.4%; post-sale it is 9.8%. The disposition was for investment purposes in the ordinary course, not control-related. This is a routine portfolio adjustment, not a special situation, as it lacks deal structure, premium, or strategic intent.
